_readme: S721 (lever), the gap census's reader_page_assignment lever (run 45371224551): Saddleback College's 7 programs on the lever, whose filed record places none of the state's listed courses because the capture handed each another program's entry, and for which the 2026-2027 catalog prints no entry. Free page read 45382520936 read the host's catalog list (one catalog, 'Saddleback 2026-2027 Spring', id 4420) and the Credit Programs A-Z entry with the data its scripts fetch; read 45383732976 searched that section's whole navigation call (parentId 48776, 208,699 bytes) for retailing, school-age care, a master teacher, a site supervisor and a business information worker, and found none. These are filed as named gaps and are never sent to a paid read. Their filed records stay as filed (the load skips a record that places none). No model call, no Supabase write. They are the college's to settle in COCI.

reasons.not_in_catalog: The 2026-2027 catalog prints no entry for the program: its Credit Programs A-Z navigation, which lists every credit program the catalog prints, names none of its title's words, so no page holds a section a read could place its courses from.
